description: Ratify nine connected, equal-population cantons while independently moving census caravans change which households fall on each side of six adjustable borders.
name: Charter of the Nine Cantons V3 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Drag the dark border handles along their rails. Household centers determine their canton. Click the folded census folios on the map to inspect traveling households and their row registers; the revealed household maps stay visible and update live. Use their household positions and population feedback to place the borders. Open the census, then adjust the six borders as caravans move. Inspection remains available during the live census and does not pause it. Keep all nine cantons population-balanced and the holdings exactly 5 Gilt, 2 Tide and 2 Plum to fill the continuous 30-second ratification audit. Any imbalance resets the audit streak; restore balance to recover. Ratification completes automatically. Early sealing or the 120-second census deadline ends the attempt. Trails show the last half-second. Use only screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
